title: Super Bowl LVII
overview: Super Bowl LVII, played on February 12, 2023, at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Arizona, saw the Kansas City Chiefs defeat the Philadelphia Eagles 38-35 in a high-scoring, back-and-forth thriller that featured lead changes, historic performances, and a dramatic final drive. The victory marked the Chiefs’ second Super Bowl title in four seasons and further cemented Patrick Mahomes’ legacy as one of the defining quarterbacks of his generation.
